answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the vault fee to keep them eligible. Because the tundra decay is applied at each close, the terrace audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 29% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 57 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
